entities.summary: Playa de las Américas is a purpose-built holiday resort in Tenerife, one of the Canary Islands of Spain. It is located in the southern and southern-west part of the Municipality of Arona, close to the adjoining Municipality of Adeje in the west of Tenerife. It was built in the 1960s a few miles distant from the fishing village of Los Cristianos. Playa de las Americas now (2021) is part of the contiguous touristic construction zone lining Tenerife's entire southwestern coast. The resort area features bars, nightclubs, restaurants, attractions, and beaches, most of which are man-made with imported sand from Africa due to the darkness of the native volcanic sand.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Playa de las Américas was a significant tourist destination in the 1970s and 1980s, attracting millions of visitors and contributing to the economic growth of the Canary Islands. Its construction also led to the development of new infrastructure and services in the region.
